def run(cfg=None, n=None, steps=None, seed=0, passes=32, Xtr=None, ytr=None, mod=T, **over):

    if Xtr is None:

# LDA / nearest class mean / QDA
means=np.stack([Xs[y==c].mean(0) for c in range(10)]); priors=np.bincount(y,minlength=10)/len(y)
cov=sum(((Xs[y==c]-means[c]).T@(Xs[y==c]-means[c])) for c in range(10))/len(y); ic=np.linalg.inv(cov)
lda=np.stack([-0.5*((Xds-means[c])@ic*(Xds-means[c])).sum(1)+np.log(priors[c]) for c in range(10)],1)
print('LDA', (lda.argmax(1)==yd).mean(), 'LDA no prior', (lda-np.log(priors)).argmax(1).__eq__(yd).mean())
qda=[]
for c in range(10):
    Z=Xs[y==c]-means[c]; C=Z.T@Z/len(Z)+0.05*np.eye(32); ic=np.linalg.inv(C)
    qda.append(-0.5*((Xds-means[c])@ic*(Xds-means[c])).sum(1)-0.5*np.linalg.slogdet(C)[1]+np.log(priors[c]))
print('QDA', (np.stack(qda,1).argmax(1)==yd).mean())
# gold-label CV on dev itself (5-fold LDA/knn) for ceiling sense
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); perm=rng.permutation(1000); acc=[]

    m=np.stack([Xds[tr][yd[tr]==c].mean(0) if (yd[tr]==c).any() else np.zeros(32) for c in range(10)])
    pr=np.bincount(yd[tr],minlength=10)/len(tr)+1e-3
    sc=np.stack([-0.5*((Xds[te]-m[c])**2).sum(1)+np.log(pr[c]) for c in range(10)],1); acc.append((sc.argmax(1)==yd[te]).mean())
